name: Hearthvale action-adventure kit
blurb: Everything for a top-down action-adventure: a hero and villagers, seven kinds of enemy and two bosses, meadow, shore, village and dungeon ground, bushes to cut, blocks to push, switches, walls and cave mouths to blast open, bombs, keys and hearts, tool icons, item slots and a dungeon map, 34 sounds and six tracks.

assets: tools/lib/assets.mjs: kitSize(plan) (a plan's own size, for a plan of any game type, else the size rule that holds today); KIT_SIZE and SMALL_KIT_SIZE stay unchanged; loadPlans checks a plan's size (two whole numbers, lo <= hi). The same helper as the Gridline kit's GH0, without its puzzle-only limit
tests/helpers/kits.mjs: sizeProblems(bundle, plan) against kitSize(plan); kitProblems passes its plan
tools/bundles-from-plans.mjs: the size note uses kitSize(plan)
tests/e2e/three-bundles.spec.mjs: the per-kit size check passes the kit's plan
tests/unit/build-kits-helper.test.mjs: tests for kitSize and sizeProblems with and without a plan
catalog/schema.js (optional): a game type for action-adventure; until then the kit is top-down-rpg
needs: the Loadout owner's yes to the kit-size rule change (not settled by this specification)
